recognize_zh: 膝部 X 光片可見遠端股骨骨幹/幹骺端有數個邊界清楚的卵圓形透亮溶骨病灶，周圍有細薄硬化邊緣，股骨髁附近亦有類似透亮區；多發、邊界清楚的溶骨性病灶配合皮疹與骨髓發現，符合蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症。
features: Radiograph of the knee (distal femur, patella region and proximal tibia) displayed horizontally
Multiple well-defined oval lytic lesions in the distal femoral diaphysis and metaphysis
Thin sclerotic rims around the lesions (geographic, non-aggressive pattern)
Additional lucent lesion near the distal femoral condyle/epiphyseal region
No visible pathologic fracture or aggressive periosteal reaction; image photographed from a screen
describe_en: Plain radiograph of the knee shows multiple well-circumscribed oval lytic lesions in the distal femoral diaphysis and metaphysis with thin sclerotic margins, and an additional lucency near the distal femoral condyle. The lesions have a geographic, non-aggressive appearance without obvious pathologic fracture or periosteal reaction. Image quality is limited because the film was photographed from a display. In a patient with skin rash and Langerhans cells in the bone marrow, these multifocal lytic lesions are consistent with multisystem Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Myeloma lesions are punched-out without sclerotic rims and occur in older adults, with plasma cells rather than Langerhans cells on biopsy.
Infection is usually solitary with thick reactive sclerosis and clinical signs of infection.
Metastases tend to be permeative or ill-defined, and biopsy shows carcinoma or small round blue cells rather than Langerhans cells.
Fibrous dysplasia shows ground-glass matrix and bone expansion rather than punched-out lucencies.
